 th  Dated this the 16 day of March, 2018  JUDGMENT The petitioner has approached this Court aggrieved by Ext.P3 notice issued to him directing the petitioner to close down the 'Indian Coffee House outlet' conducted by it, on the ground that, certain unhygienic practices were noticed by the respondent Corporation in the said outlet.

It is the case of the petitioner that, Ext.P3 notice was issued without a prior notice to the petitioner, and without hearing the petitioner in respect of the proposals that were confirmed through Ext.P3.
It is stated that, immediately on receipt of Ext.P3 notice, the petitioner has preferred Ext. P4 reply before the respondent Corporation.
2. I have heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and also the learned Standing counsel for the respondent Corporation.

The learned Standing Counsel for the respondent Corporation would submit that, the inspection conducted by the respondent Corporation reveals certain defects in the running of the Indian Coffee House outlet, and it is under these circumstances that Ext.P3 notice was issued to the petitioner.

Taking note of the submission of the learned Standing Counsel for the respondent Corporation, and finding that there was no prior notice before Ext.P3 notice served on the petitioner, I dispose the writ petition with a direction to the respondent Corporation to treat Ext.P3 as a 'show cause notice'
proposing the action mentioned therein against the petitioner, and to take a final decision in the matter after considering Ext.P4 objection submitted by the petitioner, and any subsequent objections preferred by the petitioner at the time of hearing.
To enable the respondent Corporation to do so, I direct the petitioner to appear before the Secretary of the respondent Corporation, at his office, at 11.00 am on 21.03.2018.

The respondent Corporation shall, pass fresh orders, as directed,
within a period of one week thereafter.
The writ petition is disposed as above.
